trailhead.label: Morteratsch station and Hotel Morteratsch, the board’s start

cautions: Busy with walkers and children in summer: keep your dog close.
Beyond the wooden bridge the way to the glacier tongue crosses scree and a rock step: not part of this walk.
Never let your dog onto the glacier or the meltwater streams.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Beyond the wooden bridge the way to the: Oltre il ponte di legno la via verso la lingua del ghiacciaio attraversa ghiaioni e un gradino roccioso: non fa parte di questa escursione.
textIt.Never let your dog onto the glacier or t: Non lasciare mai andare il cane sul ghiacciaio o nei torrenti di fusione.
